page.layout: One printed page, title page, all lines centred. Upper area: a title block, shown partly upside down and mirrored (show-through from the reverse side, not transcribed). Centre: a library stamp (not transcribed). Lower centre: a faint engraving with a printed imprint beneath it.
page.notes: Scan is very faint. The large title block at the top (HOC EST SPECIMEN QUAESTIONUM IN NOVUM INSTRUMENTUM DE FILIO HOMINIS) is printed upside down and mirrored; it is show-through from the reverse, so it is not transcribed. The text near the middle is faint and the readings "AUCTORE", "IACOBO GILIARDO" and "LOVANII" are doubtful. The engraving and the stamp "BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS" are not transcribed. Handwritten pencil notes in the left margin are not printed text and are omitted. The year line at the bottom is unreadable.
